First immunotherapy for MSI-H/dMMR LARC
First-mover status can drive uptake in a defined biomarker segment (5–10% of cases).
AZUR-1 cCR12 investigator 68% (98/144)
Strong efficacy supports adoption; may influence guidelines and demand.
Priority Review and expedited approval
Accelerates time to market, pulling forward potential revenue/royalties.
Safety largely consistent; 3% discontinuation
Manageable safety aids real-world use and persistence on therapy.
No recurrences among responders (2+ yrs)
Durability may sustain clinician confidence and long-term use.
